fixture_name: Express-collector corridor planning study — Canada TAC planning (Toronto context, PD-licensed portal)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Corridor-wide simultaneous transfer-permission and signage changes at three interchanges on a 420,000 AADT facility is a credible human-factors decision-load hazard squarely relevant to planning-stage sequencing; not vacuous.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal network-impact claim is anchored by the verbatim EV-CA-003 quote ('avoid introducing collisions elsewhere along the route') and factual scenario elements rest on recorded corridor inputs; mechanism honestly flagged as inference, no invented specifics.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern with no compliance assertion; the audit-objective quote is used to ground a safety concern rather than conflated with a regulatory requirement, keeping categories distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: quarterly per-interchange rollout with defined before/after speed-differential monitoring gives an actionable sequence and measurable check; not null.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU applicability explicitly assessed and acknowledged as not applicable since the controlled-access express-collector mainline excludes pedestrians and cyclists, with users scoped to vehicle occupants.

justifications.substance: Scope-boundary ambiguity at planning stage is a genuine procedural gap, but the finding names no specific conflicting constraints or their safety consequences, leaving relevance abstract.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-CA-003 verbatim supports the all-road-users consequence and EV-CA-006 anchors stage terminology, but the pivotal claim of conflicting continuity records cites no evidence_id or quote, capping grounding at 1.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance_question distinct from any asserted safety concern, with Planning Stage RSA / Alberta Stage 1 semantics properly used per EV-CA-006.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Actionable and viable: names the reconciling actor (ministry planning office), the action, and a recording step tying resolution back to the audit boundary.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not applicable within the controlled-access corridor but are explicitly acknowledged, including downstream arterial propagation, matching the acknowledge-not-applicable tier.
